claude_proposed_widenings.name: bond_objects
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core deterministic mechanic is creating a durable adhesive bond between two objects after a setting delay. The current surface has object attachments, durations, and item transforms, but no effect that joins two objects into a bonded state with constrained break conditions.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "This viscous, milky-white substance can form a permanent adhesive bond between any two objects."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: UseCountCap.random_found_amount
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's consumable stock is initialized randomly when found rather than having a fixed cap or a progression-derived cap. Existing activation resources only allow fixed or progression-based capacities.
